text: Williams Hospital concentrates 100 percent of its payouts in one account and is only 1.2 years old, but the resemblance to a ghost stops there: 124 claims are spread across four doctors, its top broker supplies just 32.3 percent of inflow, and a fifth of its patients have return visits or wider graph history. A young clinic banking in one place is common and honest. The rule surfaces the payout feature at low severity so it cannot hide; nothing here corroborates escalation. Next step: none unless a future alert implicates the same account.
